Above the interior fold the right root x_+ is a strict minimum, and is in the water column precisely when x_+>−b, yielding the two branches of ρ_frag and the strict inequality for fragmentation. Positive-length components on both sides require levels strictly below both side maxima and strictly above the trough; the possible singletons at equality are excluded. For fixed b>ν and H>z_c the bottom score exceeds the incipient shallow peak for sufficiently small ε, so this peak-to-trough gap is indeed the near-onset two-band threshold interval. Independent bisection reproduces the illustrated extrema and gap. In the frozen display ν is written u in its first definition; the positive root and proof fix its meaning unambiguously.
